a.xlink:title: DRT:Customer: A person who books DRT trips. The customer makes the reservation and may travel or book for other passengers.

DRT:madeBy: Links a reservation to the customer who made it.
DRT:Passenger: A person who travels on a DRT trip under a reservation.
DRT:hasPassenger: Links a reservation to a passenger who travels under it.

DRT:assigned_to: Links a reservation to the ride (vehicle run) to which it is assigned.

DRT:complies_with: Links a reservation to a booking rule that it must comply with, for example a minimum prior notice.
Dtx:Plan: Plan provides an extension point for users of the ontology to describe an agent's plan that may be impacted by an event.

time:Interval: A temporal entity with an extent or duration
DRT:hasPickupTimeWindow: Links a reservation to the time interval in which the passenger must be picked up.
DRT:hasDropoffTimeWindow: Links a reservation to the time interval in which the passenger must be dropped off.

DRT:includesTrip: Links a ride to a passenger trip that it includes.

DRT:operatesOn: Links a ride to the DRT line (route) on which it operates.

DRT:usesVehicle: Links a ride to the DRT shuttle that performs it.

DRT:Departs_from: Links a DRT trip to the stop where the passenger is picked up.
DRT:Arrives_at: Links a DRT trip to the stop where the passenger is dropped off.
GTFS:Agency: A transit agency whose services are described in the feed. It corresponds to the file agency.txt of the GTFS reference.
GTFS:hasAgency: Links a route to the agency that operates it.
GTFS:Trips: A journey of a vehicle along a route at a given time, serving a sequence of stops. It corresponds to the file trips.txt of the…
GTFS:hasRoute: Links a trip to the route it belongs to.

GTFS:belongsToTrip: Links a stop time to the trip it belongs to.
GTFS:servesStop: Links a stop time to the stop that it serves.
Infrastructure:Streets: A street used by vehicles and pedestrians, made of one or more road segments.
DRT:is_located_on_Streets: Links a stop to the street on which it is located.

Infrastructure:vehicle: A motorised or non-motorised means of transport used on roads to move people or goods.
Infrastructure:RunsOnStreet: Links a vehicle to a street on which it runs.

Infrastructure:Intersection: A junction where several streets meet, where vehicles and pedestrians follow signage to take the right direction.
Infrastructure:connectedToIntersection: Links a road segment to an intersection at one of its ends.

Infrastructure:Neighborhood: A geographically delimited urban area that comprises streets, points of interest and other urban infrastructure elements. A…

Events:AffectsActor: Links an impact to an actor that it affects, such as a passenger, a vehicle or an operator.
Events:PlaceImpact: An impact of an event on a place of the transport network, such as a blocked road segment, a closed street or an unavailable stop.
